description: MACF agent hooks: dependency installer, work check, SessionEnd + PreCompact peer-notification (UC-1 per DR-023; moved off the per-turn Stop hook in macf#673 to stop blocking the TUI every turn — distinguishable session-end vs session-compact events), PreCompact-hook session checkpoint (UC-3 per DR-023), the turn-state marker that lets the channel server report accurate live agent state through long tool waits (DR-030 phase-1, groundnuty/macf#568), and the single-sourced load-bearing guard set (DR-039 Decision 2, groundnuty/macf#731/#739): gh-token attribution-trap (#140), mention-routing-hygiene (#244/#272), LGTM-gate (#270), close-keyword-guard (#431), attribution result-invariant backstop (#489), reflection-harvest (#500), channel-server liveness guard (#734), and the framework-surface git-sweep guard pair (#814): check-framework-surface.sh (SessionStart — detects a swept/missing plugin mount, identity config, or guard-hook set and warns loud to run `macf update`) + check-git-sweep.sh (PreToolUse Bash — blocks `git stash -u`/`--include-untracked`/`-a`/`--all` and `git clean` force+directories combos when the untracked macf framework surface would actually be swept), and the close-condition guard (#1231): check-close-condition.sh (PreToolUse Bash — on `gh issue close`, surfaces the issue's own stated closing condition, if any, via the PreToolUse `additionalContext` allow-contract; never blocks — see the script's own header for why warn-only was the deliberate choice over a block-once form), and its create-time sibling (#1248): check-close-condition-create.sh (PreToolUse Bash — on `gh issue create`, when the body states a closing condition, surfaces the three grading criteria (observable / satisfiable only by the repair / falsifiable when unmet) via the same `additionalContext` allow-contract, WITHOUT adjudicating whether the stated condition meets them; a body with no stated condition produces no output at all — distinct `MACF_SKIP_CONDITION_GRADE_CHECK` override, deliberately not shared with check-close-condition.sh's `MACF_SKIP_CLOSE_CONDITION_CHECK`), the close-and-ping guard (#1385): check-close-and-ping.sh (PreToolUse Bash — on `gh issue close`, enumerates the issue's inbound `cross-referenced` timeline events, filters to sources that are still OPEN, and surfaces each as a candidate to ping via the same `additionalContext` allow-contract, WITH the reason it fired (`#N closed; you referenced it and are still open`); zero open candidates produces no output at all — true silence, same posture as check-close-condition-create.sh, deliberately NOT check-close-condition.sh's always-a-note posture, since most closes have no waiters and a nothing-to-report note on every close would itself become the noise this hook exists to prevent; distinct `MACF_SKIP_CLOSE_PING_CHECK` override), and the resumed-session identity guard (#664): emit-agent-identity.sh (SessionStart, deliberately matcher-less — fires on startup/resume/clear/compact/fork — surfaces this agent's project/agent_name/agent_role/routing_label from `.macf/macf-agent.json` or the `MACF_*` environment into context on EVERY session start, closing the gap where a `claude -c` resume never re-ran the old session-start-only identity lookup; honest-unknown, never a guess, when neither source resolves; NEVER invokes `macf-whoami.sh`, which reports token attribution class, not agent identity — see coordination.md's corrected Token & Git Hygiene §2). As of DR-039 phase 2 (groundnuty/macf#698), these scripts live in the plugin (`packages/macf/plugin/scripts/`, joining `mark-turn-state.sh`) and are invoked via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/<name>.sh — tamper-resistant, since an agent can no longer defeat an enforcement hook by editing its workspace `.claude/scripts/` copy. A compat copy is still distributed to `.claude/scripts/` by `macf init`/`update` for hand-wired substrate hooks + non-plugin-init'd workspaces, pending full DR-039 substrate rollout.

hooks.command: w="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; [ -f "$w/.git" ] && grep -q '^gitdir: ' "$w/.git" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; echo 'Run /macf-status to see your identity and peers, then /macf-issues to check pending work.'
